title: Resourcing a £120m highways programme at pace
challenge: Kier needed to scale a regional highways team from 12 to 40 skilled site and engineering staff within a single quarter, without compromising on compliance or culture fit.
approach: Abatec embedded a dedicated account team on-site, built a compliant temp-to-perm talent pipeline, and ran weekly calibration sessions with Kier's regional director.
result: 38 placements made within 11 weeks, 94% retention at the 6-month mark, and a preferred supplier agreement now in its fourth year.

title: Specialist engineering talent for a live rail upgrade
challenge: A live rail electrification project required engineers with rare combined signalling and civils experience, under strict security vetting timelines.
approach: Abatec's engineering desk tapped a pre-vetted specialist network, fast-tracking BPSS and security clearance in parallel with technical screening.
result: 6 senior engineers placed inside clearance deadlines, zero project delay, and a 100% offer-acceptance rate.
